instruction: I need to reorganize my presentation by moving the last slide to be the second slide. Could you open the LibreOffice Impress file on my Desktop, move slide 9 to position 2, and save the file?

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving slide 9 (titled 'Page Title') to position 2 (index 1). Evaluator verifies that 'Page Title' is now at index 1.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification: Only checks that 'Page Title' ends up at position 2, but doesn't verify it was originally the last slide (slide 9)
Missing precondition verification: Doesn't verify the presentation originally had 9 slides or that 'Page Title' was at position 9
No verification of side effects: Doesn't check that other slides shifted correctly when slide 9 moved to position 2
Weak slide identification: Uses 'first text shape as title' which could match multiple slides or fail on slides without text
Cannot distinguish between move vs copy/duplicate: Evaluator would pass if 'Page Title' was copied to position 2 instead of moved
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Verify slide count: Check that result has exactly 9 slides to ensure no slides were added/deleted
Verify multiple slide positions: Check that not only 'Page Title' is at index 1, but also verify 1-2 other slides maintained relative order
Add original position verification: In metadata, document that 'Page Title' should originally be at position 9, and optionally verify the previous slide at position 2 moved to position 3
Improve slide identification: Use more robust title extraction or consider checking slide content beyond just the first text shape
Consider checking full slide order: Instead of just checking one position, verify the complete expected order: [slide1, Page Title, slide2, slide3, ...]
